mcqs.question:
With reference to the NRSC (ISRO) analysis of Oceansat-3 data on the El Niño impact, consider the following statements:
1. The analysis covered April–June data from 2023–2026.
2. The productive zone contracted westward.
3. The analysis combined OCM-3 chlorophyll data with Sea Surface Temperature Monitor data.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: NRSC (ISRO) analysed April–June data from 2023–2026 and found that the productive zone contracted westward. Statement 3 is incorrect because the analysis combined OCM-3 chlorophyll data with scatterometer winds, not Sea Surface Temperature Monitor data.

mcqs.question: Oceansat-3 (EOS-06), the third-generation Oceansat, was launched on which date and by which launch vehicle from Sriharikota?
mcqs.explanation: Oceansat-3 was launched on November 26, 2022, by PSLV-C54 from Sriharikota. The other options change the year, launch vehicle or date.

mcqs.question: Which set of payloads was carried by Oceansat-3 (EOS-06)?
options: Ocean Colour Monitor-3, Ku-band Scatterometer, Sea Surface Temperature Monitor and ARGOS
Ocean Colour Monitor-3, Ku-band Scatterometer, Synthetic Aperture Radar and ARGOS
Ocean Colour Monitor-2, Ku-band Scatterometer, Sea Surface Temperature Monitor and ARGOS
Ocean Colour Monitor-3, C-band Scatterometer, Sea Surface Temperature Monitor and ARGOS
mcqs.explanation: The payloads of Oceansat-3 were Ocean Colour Monitor-3, Ku-band Scatterometer (SCAT-3), Sea Surface Temperature Monitor and ARGOS. The other options alter one of the listed payloads.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The NM-ICPS achievements included 1,146 technologies.
Reason (R): The NM-ICPS achievements included 1,329 start-ups.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true because 1,146 technologies were among the achievements of NM-ICPS as of August 2026. Reason R is false: the figure 1,329 referred to products, while the number of start-ups was 1,136.

mcqs.question:
Match the institutions associated with the Technology Translation Research Parks with their domains:

List-I
 a. IIT Kanpur
 b. IISc Bengaluru
 c. IIT (ISM) Dhanbad
 d. IIT Indore

List-II
 i. Cybersecurity
 ii. Robotics and AI
 iii. Mining
 iv. Digital healthcare

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are IIT Kanpur–Cybersecurity, IISc Bengaluru–Robotics and AI, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad–Mining, and IIT Indore–Digital healthcare. The other codes interchange these institutional domains.

mcqs.question: In the context of NM-ICPS achievements, CHANAKYA stands for:
options: Comprehensive and Holistic Advancement of National Knowledge Yield and Analytics
Comprehensive and Holistic Advancement of National Knowledge, Youth and Analytics
Centralised and Holistic Advancement of National Knowledge Yield and Applications
Comprehensive and High-level Advancement of National Knowledge Yield and Analytics
mcqs.explanation: CHANAKYA expands to Comprehensive and Holistic Advancement of National Knowledge Yield and Analytics. The other options change one or more words in the expansion.

mcqs.question: Which BharatGen model is a foundation model with 17 billion parameters covering all 22 Scheduled languages?
mcqs.explanation: Param-2 is the BharatGen foundation model with 17 billion parameters for all 22 Scheduled languages. Shrutam is for speech-to-text, Sooktam for text-to-speech and Patram for documents.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following statements about BharatGen is incorrect?
options: Shrutam is a speech-to-text model for 12 languages.
Shrutam is a speech-to-text model for 22 languages.
Sooktam is a text-to-speech model for 12 languages.
Param-2 is a foundation model covering all 22 Scheduled languages.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement changes Shrutam’s language coverage to 22 languages. Shrutam is a speech-to-text model for 12 languages; 22 Scheduled languages is associated with Param-2.

mcqs.question: Which BharatGen model is designed for text-to-speech in 12 languages?
mcqs.explanation: Sooktam is BharatGen’s text-to-speech model for 12 languages. Shrutam is the speech-to-text model, while Patram is for documents and Param-2 is the foundation model.

mcqs.question: Which BharatGen model is associated with documents and the DocBodh framework?
mcqs.explanation: Patram is the BharatGen model for documents and is associated with the DocBodh framework. The other models have foundation-model, text-to-speech or speech-to-text purposes.

mcqs.question: Which set correctly matches the BharatGen models with their purposes?
options: Ayur Param—Ayurveda; Agri Param—agriculture; Legal Param—legal
Ayur Param—agriculture; Agri Param—legal; Legal Param—Ayurveda
Ayur Param—legal; Agri Param—Ayurveda; Legal Param—agriculture
Ayur Param—documents; Agri Param—speech-to-text; Legal Param—text-to-speech
mcqs.explanation: Ayur Param, Agri Param and Legal Param are intended respectively for Ayurveda, agriculture and legal applications. The other options interchange or replace these purposes.

mcqs.question:
Match the applications with their associated institutions or descriptions:

List-I
 a. CharakDT
 b. Agri-IoT Farm Management System
 c. TEXMiN
 d. Indigenous 5G-Advanced ORAN Massive MIMO Radio Unit

List-II
 i. Drishti CPS Foundation, IIT Indore
 ii. IIT Bombay
 iii. Mining drones transmitting data up to 50 km
 iv. IIIT Bengaluru

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: CharakDT is associated with Drishti CPS Foundation at IIT Indore; the Agri-IoT Farm Management System with IIT Bombay; TEXMiN with mining drones transmitting data up to 50 km; and the 5G-Advanced ORAN Massive MIMO Radio Unit with IIIT Bengaluru. The other codes interchange these applications and institutions.

mcqs.question: Which NM-ICPS application is associated with the IHUB NTIHAC Foundation at IIT Kanpur?
options: IT-OT Security Operations Centre and crypto-forensic tools
Digital twin of the human body
Accident-prone spot alerts piloted in Nagpur
India’s first proving ground for autonomous navigation
mcqs.explanation: The IHUB NTIHAC Foundation at IIT Kanpur developed an IT-OT Security Operations Centre and crypto-forensic tools. The other options refer to applications associated with IIT Indore, IISc’s robotics hub and TiHAN Foundation respectively.

mcqs.question: Which NM-ICPS application was described as India’s first proving ground for autonomous navigation?
options: IHUB NTIHAC Foundation at IIT Kanpur
Drishti CPS Foundation at IIT Indore
mcqs.explanation: TiHAN Foundation at IIT Hyderabad was described as India’s first proving ground for autonomous navigation. The other institutions are associated with cybersecurity, a digital human-body twin or mining applications.

mcqs.question: The iRASTE application, which provides accident-prone spot alerts, was piloted in which place?
mcqs.explanation: iRASTE, associated with the IISc robotics hub, was piloted in Nagpur for accident-prone spot alerts. The other places are linked to institutions or domains in the NM-ICPS ecosystem, not this pilot.
